Thank you for contributing to KupCAD. This agreement is between you and Oleksii Vasyliev, who

Contributor License Agreement, version 2.2.

You accept this agreement by signing it through CLA Assistant on your first pull request. It
then covers that Contribution and every Contribution you submit after it.

## 1. Definitions

- **"You"** means the individual who signs this agreement.
- **"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any changes or additions
  to existing work, that You intentionally submit to the Maintainer for inclusion in KupCAD:
  through a pull request, a patch, an issue or any other communication sent to the KupCAD
  repositories or their maintainers. Something You mark in writing as "Not a Contribution" when
  You send it is not a Contribution.
